name: dropdown
title: Dropdown
description: Opens a short list of actions or values from a button.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens the menu. Rendered with `asChild`, so pass a Button.

props.name: children
props.description: `DropdownMenuItem`s, optionally inside `DropdownMenuGroup`s; also `DropdownMenuSub`s, `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem`s and `DropdownMenuRadioGroup`s.

props.name: modal
props.description: Modal menus block the rest of the page while open.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target, for the menu and its submenus. Defaults to `document.body`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the menu, when the trigger's text doesn't say enough.

props.name: onFocusOutside
props.description: Focus moved outside a non-modal menu; call `preventDefault()` to keep it open.

props.name: dir
props.description: Reading direction: which arrow opens a submenu and the side it opens on. Read from the trigger when left out.

DropdownMenuGroup.description: A titled group of items (Figma `_dropdown/group`). Groups get a rule between them.

props.name: label
props.description: The 24px group header.

MenuItemContent.description: What sits inside a menu row: icon, label and description, then shortcut and check.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon. 16px by default; stacked two-line items may use 20px (`iconSize={20}`).

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the current value: a trailing check.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keys that run the item, e.g. "⌘N", shown on the right (Figma's `showShortcut`).

props.name: renderLabel
props.description: Wraps the label, e.g. in Radix Select's `ItemText`.

DropdownMenuSub.description: A submenu: holds the row that opens it, a `DropdownMenuSubTrigger`, and its panel, a `DropdownMenuSubContent` with the submenu's rows. Renders no element of its own.

props.name: children
props.description: A `DropdownMenuSubTrigger` and its `DropdownMenuSubContent`.

DropdownMenuSubTrigger.description: The row that opens a submenu: an item's look, ending in a text/muted chevron (mirrored right to left). It stays filled bg/selected while its submenu is open. Hover, →, Enter or Space opens it. Other props, `ref` included, go to the row (the Radix SubTrigger).

DropdownMenuSubContent.description: A submenu's panel: the menu's surface, 220px wide, beside its row with the first rows level (4px off). It fades in from 4px on the side it opens, so it seems to come out of the row; right to left, or with no room on the right, that is the left. Other props, `ref` included, go to the panel (the Radix SubContent).

props.name: children
props.description: The submenu's rows: `DropdownMenuItem`s, groups, checkable rows, or another `DropdownMenuSub`.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target. Defaults to the menu's own `container`.

DropdownMenuCheckboxItem.description: A row that turns something on or off, like a column of a view: a leading 16px checkbox (the Checkbox's look) before the item's content. Its role is `menuitemcheckbox`, with `aria-checked`. Enter or Space toggles it; the menu stays open unless `closeOnSelect`. Other props, `ref` included, go to the row (the Radix CheckboxItem).

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled state. `'indeterminate'` for a row that stands for a set only partly on.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: The state it starts in, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: The row was toggled; an indeterminate row turns on.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Closes the menu once toggled. Off, so several rows can be set in one go.

DropdownMenuRadioGroup.description: One choice among `DropdownMenuRadioItem`s, like a sort order or a stage: a group with the `DropdownMenuGroup` look (header, rule under it). Other props, `ref` included, go to the group (the Radix RadioGroup).

props.name: label
props.description: The 24px group header; it also names the group for screen readers.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled: the selected row's `value`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The row selected at first, when uncontrolled.

DropdownMenuRadioItem.description: One option in a `DropdownMenuRadioGroup`. The selected row is filled bg/selected and ends in the same status-green check as a `selected` item. Its role is `menuitemradio`, with `aria-checked`. Other props, `ref` included, go to the row (the Radix RadioItem).

props.name: value
props.description: What `onValueChange` reports when this row is chosen.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Closes the menu once chosen. On, since one choice ends the question.
